brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth bins placed: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on two adjacent hex bases (0,0,0 and 1,0,0) bolted together.
Both bins are solid non-drained variant hex-bin-full (no drain holes, no PVC bore), so they retain liquids - waterproof tray for utensils.
Bins are standard injection-molded polypropylene trays (hex-bin-full) which are dishwasher safe; no wood, electronics or inserts. Configurator offers only plastic bins.

finish.summary: Built utensil holder as two adjacent hex cells each with solid full-depth bin (hex-bin-full). Solid bins are waterproof (no drainage holes). Standard plastic bins are dishwasher safe. Structure locked with joint bolt and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
